scorecard.venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c T Natarajan b PJ Cummins

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c Nithish Kumar Reddy b B Kumar

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c Sanvir Singh b B Kumar

balls.text: Is that four or has Nitish just saved two runs for his team? A high full toss outside off, he slaps it over deep cover. Nitish leaps, one-handed and tries to keep the ball inside the field of play. But he can't get much force on it and the ball bounces and touches the advertising hoarding
Oh, what wrist-work from Pooran. Slower good length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat and places it in the gap between short fine and point
Back of a length ball outside off, he flat-bats to long off
Scythes over point! Length ball angling across Pooran who flashes hard, gets it off the outer half of the bat and for four
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he cuts it hard to deep cover
That is a top shot from Badoni. Low full toss outside off, he goes reverse and places it to the left of point.
Low full toss on Pooran's pads, who accepts the gift with glee by helping it past short fine leg. 15 off that over and Natarajan has gone for 4-0-50-0!
Fifty off 28 balls for Badoni! Stunning knock by the youngster. Low full toss outside off, he slices it to deep point. Such an important knock
Gets the yorker right for once. Wide yorker well outside off, Badoni can't get any bat on it.
Too wide and Badoni gets four more. Low full angling across the batter. But Badoni is up to the task. He gets well across and slams it to the right of mid-off who can't do much
Banged in short, he hammers the pull to the right of long off. gets two more
Lofted over mid-off! Was too full outside off, he clears his front leg and drives past mid-off

Yes, he can. Badoni gives himself room but Bhuvi follows him and nails the yorker. Badoni can only whisk it to deep midwicket. Nitish then hares from the deep and keeps them down to one. Bhuvi ends with figures of 4-0-12-2
Another stellar yorker on off stump, nothing Pooran can do but dig it out towards extra cover's left
124.2kph back of a length ball on off stump, he flat-bats it to long off.
128kph length ball well outside off stump, he slaps it to deep cover
Shin-high full toss just outside off, he drives but can't beat extra cover. Didn't get the room to free his arms
Nails the yorker on off stump. He can only jam it to mid-off
Yorker on his pads, he digs it to the on-side with the bowler giving chase
Four more! Slower good length ball well outside off, he cuts it hard and past point. No stopping that.
Oh, wow. That is some shot! Fuller in length on off stump, he jumps right across and sweeps to the vacant deep square leg fence
Fuller on leg stump, he drives to long-off for a run
Good placement but the fielder also does well. Was a slower back of a length ball on off, he pulls to the right of deep midwicket for two more. That's the fifty of the partnership off 33 balls.
Ah, he's missed out there. Low full toss down leg, any bat on it and would have been four. Misses, but does get a wide
Slower length ball angling across Badoni outside off. He taps it to point with an open face of the blade. Pooran sets off for a quick run
Slower back of a length ball on Badoni's hips. He helps it to deep backward square leg
Good length ball outside off, he works it towards deep midwicket with soft hands and immediately calls for two. Makes it home easily.
Slower good length ball outside off, he flat-bats it to long on
Swing and a miss! Was in the slot outside off, Pooran throws the kitchen-sink at it but does not make a connection
ooh, bonus runs. Cummins goes for the yorker, bowls this at 141kph. But the line was awry. On the pads, and Pooran effortlessly clips it down leg
Back of a length ball across Pooran who hacks it to the right of deep midwicket. The fielder does well to keep them down to two
Excellent placement again from Badoni. Was a touch short on middle and leg, he bends low and on one knee and slams it in the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Slows up the good length ball outside off, Pooran miscues it towards long off
Looks to go up and over but misses. Was floated on leg stump, he was looking to go straight by backing away, gets an inside-edge onto his pad
BANG! Dropped short on off stump, was the wrong'un but was too short. Pooran pulls it over the deep midwicket fence
Legbreak on leg stump. Pooran is cramped for room and ticks it to square leg
Wrong'un, was short in length but also slower. Badoni looks to absolutely muscle the pull, can only get it off the cue end of the blade to the on-side
Low full toss on the stumps, he pushes to long on
Scooped fine, scooped for four!  Length ball on off stump, he jumps across and helps it over the left shoulder of the keeper
Natarajan goes for another slower bouncer, but again this is too high outside off. Called a wide.
Good length ball on the pads of Badoni who works it towards the square leg region with soft hands. Gets two
Edged and four! Angles the length ball across Badoni outside off, who throws his bat at it and gets it to the right of the keeper
Another slower bouncer, but this one was too short and too high. called a wide
Shot! They will need a lot of these. Back of a length ball on off, hacks it over midwicket for a crucial four
Deceived again. Natarajan gets the slower bouncer going just outside off, Badoni eyes the pull but is way too early into his shot. Toe-ends it to the offside
Back of a length ball at 129kph outside off, he stands tall and punches to sweeper cover
Slower bouncer outside off, pulled to wide long-on

nearly another wicket. Sanvir almost pulls off another low catch. Slower offcutter on middle. Badoni lofts but can't clear mid-off. The ball falls to his left even as Sanvir puts in a full-length dive forward
Slower good length ball well outside off, he cuts but can't beat point
129kph good length ball on off stump, he gets across and works it to midwicket
Starts off with a yorker, he digs it down to long-on
Slower length ball on the stumps, Badoni defends towards cover
Length just outside off, he punches to deep cover
Good length ball angling across Badoni who opens the face of the bat down to deep third
Length ball well outside off, he scythes it to deep third

Birthday boy Cummins nails a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Has he conjured a wicket out of nowhere? Oh, he has. Fielding brilliance on show again. Krunal backs away to a length ball and sets off for a quick run. But think he has hit it too well, and the ball goes at a good height to Cummins who sends the middle stump splat
On-pace length ball on off, Pooran plays with a slight open face of the bat to point
Front of the hand delivery from Viyaskanth on middle. Krunal pushes back to the bowler
Fuller, he pushes to long off
Dragged down and Pooran latches on. Was on middle and leg, he he rocks back and pulls in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square
Driven uppishly but no fielders close in on the off side. Was on a length on the stumps, he gets it to long off
Flatter at 94.8kph on middle stump, he works it to short third
Flatter on middle and leg, he ticks it to deep square leg

On-pace ball does the trick for Cummins and Rahul goes! Good length ball on leg stump, Rahul helps it fine bit does not enough bat on it. Natarajan sprints to his right from deep backward square and takes a comfortable catch.
Bouncer, think it was the slower ball, Rahul pull to wide long-on and they collect two
Oh, a direct hit and think Krunal was a goner. Good length ball on middle, he stays leg side and pats to point. Krunal was backing way too far and had Head hit, he would have been short
Low full toss on leg stump, he shimmies down but is thrown off with that full bunger and can only push to long-on
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, he ticks it to the right of midwicket
Clears mid-off. This is the first four of the innings, and it's come off Rahul's blade. On-pace ball but that is fuller outside off. Rahul clears his front leg and goes over mid-off
Wrong'un on middle stump, was bowled quicker at 94.9kph. Krunal works it to midwicket
Floated just outside off, he drives to the right of extra cover where Cummins dives full-length to his right but can't prevent a run
Ooh, the wrong'un has Rahul deceived. Was short but spun sharply back into the batter on leg stump as Rahul defends
Length on middle and leg, he ticks it towards midwicket
Tossed up at 80.8kph on leg stump. He stays leg side of the ball and opens up the off side for a run to long-off
Legbrak but the line is down leg. Krunal works it to deep backward square leg
Another slower bouncer, this time Krunal can only pull it as far as deep midwicket. Fifteen runs of the over.
1000 sixes in IPL 2024, and what a shot to get to the mark. On-pace and right in the slot for Krunal who stays still and smacks the bowler over his head and all the way
That is a top shot. Flat bats him all the way. Slower bouncer outside off. He generates all the power he has and pummels it over long on
Ooh, that went nowhere. Slower bouncer outside off, he looks for a pull, ends up toe-ending it close to surface
Slower back of a length ball on middle and leg. He looks to mow it away, but struggles to get any power on that shot. Plays it in the gap between deep backward square and conventional deep square leg
Good length ball just outside off, he is cramped for room and miscues to cover
He jumps down the track to the length ball at 95kph. Doesn't get any power though as he drags it to deep midwicket
Wrong'un now. He's showing all his skills is Vijayakanth Viyaskanth. Flatter just outside off, Krunal cuts to point
Legbreak on middle and leg, Krunal eyes a big sweep, misses and is rapped on the pads. The ball was sliding down leg though
Front of the hand legspinner this one. Was a touch short on off, he hops back and pushes to long off
Goes reverse now to the slower leggie just outside off, can't beat short third though
Keeps it slower on off stump, Krunal can only defend towards point
Floated outside off, he drives to extra cover, and that is by far the slowest powerplay of the season for LSG. They are 27 for 2 after six overs
Short and wide, but Rahul can't cash in. He's gone into defensive mode has Rahul. Goes back and cuts it but straight to extra cover
Fuller on the pads, he flicks towards deep midwicket
Flatter just outside off, he clatters it to wide long-off again, but gets only a run as Samad covers ground quickly
Tossed up on off stump, he prods forward and drives with authority to the left of long off
Just a tad short outside off, he hops back and slaps it but can't beat extra cover
Ooh, that could have been close. Length on middle, he opens the face of the bat and pushes to point. Sets off but the fielder was quick on the ball. He doesn't get  a direct hit though
Another one. Length on middle, Rahul presents the full face of the blade and pushes firmly back to the bowler
Bhuvi keeps those indippers going his way. On a length meeting Rahul on off stump, who can only defend
On a length angling away from the batter, who pushes to deep point

Another stunning catch, this time by Sanvir Singh at mid-on! Or is it? The umpires are having a look. Sanvir looks confident though. Back of a length ball that rushes on to Stoinis. He is a touch late on the pull and miscues his pull towards mid-on. The ball is dying on Sanvir, but he hares to his right, dives forward and takes the catch inches off the ground. Absolute stunner
Another sharp inswinger that strikes Rahul on the pad, but the ball was heading down leg. They steal a leg-bye as the ball rolls to the leg side
Backs away just a touch but Shahbaz follows him, cramping him for room. He can only push it to the on-side for a run

Huge appeal for lbw and the umpire agrees! But KL Rahul has reviewed almost instantly. Was there some bat/glove involved? Oh, looks like the ball hit the glove, and then grazed the pad. So, the decision will have to be overturned. Was a length ball on middle and leg, he bends low and eyes a sweep. Misses. It was straight enough but Rahul was hit on the glove there.
Slows this length ball down, was around 88.5kph on off stump. Down to long-off once more with a straight bat
Quicker again at 95.1kph just outside of, he shimmies down the track but can only get it down to long-off
Flatter at 96kph on off stump, he pushes to long off again for a run
Fuller on the stumps, he stays leg side of the ball and drives to long-off
Length on off, he taps the ball to point and takes a quick run. Just two runs and a wicket off that over
Length ball with a hint shape away from Rahul who pushes neatly but straight to extra cover
Driven on the up but he can't clear cover. Was a good length ball just outside off, he drives crisply.
Mistimes to mid-off. Back of a length ball at 129.1kph outside off, he stands tall and pushes to mid-off
Length ball just outside off with a hint of tail in. Stoinis shoulders arms

That is a super catch from Nitish Kumar Reddy! It looked for a second that the ball had evaded him, but he's held his balance brilliantly. Just the kind of awareness he's showed is superb. Bhuvneshwar goes back of a length on middle and leg as de Kock swivels and pulls to deep backward square leg. He gets a good connection, but Nitish leaps, catches the ball and upon realising he's going over the ropes, lets go of the ball comes back into the field of play and completes the catch
Back of a length ball outside off, he stands tall and guides to the left of deep point. They scamper back quickly for a couple of runs
Just short of deep backward square leg. Was a back of a length ball on middle and leg, he pulls it on the bounce. Was hit flat and going quickly to Shahbaz
Length on off stump, he scythes it to point and sets off for a quick run
Oh, what a shot! Shot of the evening already? Fuller outside off, he prods half-forward, holds his shape and goes inside out over mid-off and he times it brilliantly to clear the fence
Length on middle and leg, he works it to shirt midwicket
Fuller length ball outside off, he drives with authority but can't beat extra cover

Huge appeal for lbw, or is it for caught behind? The umpire stays unmoved. And after all that, SRH don't opt for the review. It was a sharp inswinger that caught de Kock off guard. Strikes his pad with the ball carrying to Klaasen. Think he was hit outside leg stump, though, and there was no edge
The indipper again but this one is on middle and leg. Rahul ticks it to the right of mid-on
And now the big booming inswinger. But Rahul watches it really closely as he gets half-forward and blocks
Just a touch short angling across the batter, who cuts to deep point
Fuller well outside off, he gets forward and drives to mid-off
Length ball to start off, not a lot of movement. Rahul gets across and tips it towards point and sets off
And that, my friends, is that! In the slot outside off, and butchered over extra cover. SRH have chased 166 inside 10 overs!
width outside off, and cut off the toe out to cover. A direct-hit would have been close... in the not-very-literal sense
wide line, flapped down to long-off, gets back for two
outside off, crashed up and into the off side, another single... Head needs 4, 4, 6...
tight on the back foot, tucked to the on-side, Abhishek keeps the strike, and probably ends any hope of Head winning it with a hundred...
pace off the ball, beaten as Abhishek swings a rare air-shot in the general direction of cow corner
slower ball, back of a length, on the pads, helped through fine leg. Remorseless!
swings into a pull to leg, not timed on this occasion but another single
Like pinging off the lid of a tin of treacle! Almost a perfect yorker, but out comes the bottom hand, levering the ball high over long-on again!
wiped off the good length, back over the bowler's head, mopped up at long-on
effortless and magnificent! Looped onto the toes, but what an elegant pick-up! A flick of the back leg for emphasis as the ball sails over long-on again!
belted back at the bowler who drops a flying chance! Full length, whacked straight out of the screws. That saved another boundary
another stride into the good length, eased into the off side
punishment for that dot-ball! Head steps into the length, pivots around his kneeling back leg, and assaults the ball over deep midwicket again!
Decent delivery, skids across the left-hander, tight to the off stump and beats the edge
full length, pushed across Head's bows, and cracked off the back foot through deep point!
thumped with a roll of the wrists through the covers! Another boundary to end a leaky over of part-time offies
on the back foot, nudged to the on-side, another single
skips to the pitch, driven into the off side
Abhishek's turn for a fifty! Only 19 balls! Crushed into the upper deck once more, with a mighty launch through the line and over long-on!
fired into the legs, a high elbow from Head as he takes the single to mid-on
round the wicket, yanked across the line for another flat dismissive six!
yeegads! In the slot, Head steps to the pitch, unleashes those wrists once more, and muscles another huge drive over the ropes at extra cover!
A swing and a miss! The ooh from the ground dissolves into a comparative silence. High expectations!
Up comes the hundred! Back of a length this time, Abhishek waits on his slap through the line, then unleashes back past the bowler!
banged in short, swivelled over fine leg! Round the wicket, targeting the badge, but Abhishek just swings for the stands!
shapes for the cut, angles for the wide, but that's a good delivery, just inside the tramlines. A dot!
opens the face for a sweetly guided drive past point! One step down the pitch, another poor piece of fielding! Another boundary!
makes room to leg, scythes through the covers! Over the wicket from Naveen but he can't cramp his intentions. A 12th visit to the ropes in 18 balls!
pace off, back of a length, there's no fooling Head in this mood! He pauses with a solid base, and wafts his wand through the lobbed bouncer, for another one-bounce four through the covers!
munched over wide long-on for a 16-ball 50! This is preposterous tonking! Nowhere is safe!
on the back foot, didn't seem to time it, but beats the diving man at mid-off, and that's the end of the argument! Off the ball rumbles, through the vacant long-off
full toss, that's a freebie! Off-stump line, Head just keeps his eyes on the prize and carts another four through point
onto the front foot, opens the face for another single
jeepers, what a pick-up! The ball wasn't especially short, that was a full-blooded back-foot drive, levering a huge air-ball up and over wide long-off. Extraordinary
another googly, ripping away from the bat, flashed hard to the off side
thrashed off the back foot, grabbed in the follow-through by the bowler
head over the ball, picking the googly, and crashed off the back foot through the covers
dropped at short third! That's a terrible miss... a wild hack across the line, a big spinning edge loops to Thakur, who sticks out a hand and can't close his fingers
blammed into the stands again! Up comes the fifty stand in no time at all. Misses his line and gets the treatment, down the ground!
makes room to leg, followed right into his feet and compactly blocked down into the off-side
kneels into a full proposal of a front-foot bosh! 'Sightscreen, will you marry me?' 'Yes, yes I will!'
too short, leans back and launched up and into the sightscreen! Backing away, opening his stance, levering up and into the ball!
the line is fractionally off but the hands are on it! Skids into a flat pull over square leg! I think SRH have the measure of this chase tonight!
fuller length, fenced out to the off side
step and slap! A compact stride to the ball, and drilled with superb poise high over the bowler's head!
back of a length, down the leg side! A thin deflection off the hip as Abhishek swings lustily across the line. The keeper has no chance!
gallops down the pitch, staying leg-side as he does so, and fences another four with sweet timing down through deep third<>B
now a leg-side wide as Yash loses his line
makes space to leg, creamed through backward point! Sumptuous pre-meditation, he knew where the ball would be and set himself accordingly. SRH are on their way
blapped across the line! Dragged down just a smidgeon, and Abhishek is onto it so quickly, hoisting hard through deep midwicket, for a one-bounce four inches inside the rope
round the wicket, tight line and length on the angle into off stump. Met with a solid front-foot block
tapped off the pads to the on-side

sliding into the body once more, Head swivels from deep in the crease and lifts it up and over backward square. No great timing but placed to perfection. The first four comes up some nine overs earlier than Lucknow managed...
a touch of width in the arc, and bashed at the top of the bounce to cover
fired down the leg side, no spin on offer, sliding past a flick to leg
tight into the legs again, deflected to backward square, Head has to hurry as the direct hit comes in but he's safe enough
right back on the stumps, flicking the leg-stump line to square leg
no messing about, a violent heave through the good length, not timed, but lobbed over the bowler and swept up at long-off
round the wicket, tidy length from Gowtham, into the body, tapped into the off side
